title: Support inbox sweep
goal: Answer every unanswered customer mail in the station inbox for venture {venture}, politely and truthfully, and report what was answered and what needs the Superintendent.

steps.title: Read and reply
steps.brief: With mail.search and mail.read, list the inbox threads for venture {venture} whose last message is inbound and unanswered. For each: if it is a plain question you can answer from what you know, draft a reply with mail.draft and send it with mail.send (each send waits at the Gate under outbound messages unless the leash allows it); if it asks for a refund, a return, a legal matter or anything irreversible, do not reply: list it for the Superintendent. Never promise a refund or a date you cannot see in the data. Write outbox/support/sweep-{venture}.md: threads answered (subject, one line), threads escalated and why, threads skipped (spam / platform notices).
